newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Nov external reserves set record $217.11 bln.
newsitem.headline: Japan Nov external reserves set record $217.11 bln.

text.p: Japan's external reserves rose $894 million from a month earlier to a record $217.11 billion at the end of November, the Ministry of Finance (MOF) said on Monday.
Reserves had increased $1.19 billion in October to the previous record high of $216.22 billion.
Figures may not tally due to rounding.
It is the 33rd consecutive month in which the reserves have marked a new record high, a ministry official said.
